`python3 roster.py inactive` now lists every learner whose last login was 14 or more days ago. Run against the current data, it returns two of the four learners:

```
L-002  Ben Whitlock         ben.w@example.org        2026-09-02  31 days
L-004  Dara Novak           dara@example.org         2026-08-11  53 days
```

Each line shows id, name, email, last login date and days since, sorted by name like the other commands. Exactly 14 days counts as inactive, and the threshold is the `INACTIVE_AFTER_DAYS` constant at the top of `roster.py`.

I also added the command to the usage text and the README.
